title: Man in the Dark
description:
Man in the Dark is a single-play TPS game that realistically expresses the dark feeling of the end of the century, set in a place that has turned into a place full of zombies and bizarre creatures. You don't have to go through a lot of learning to experience the great play that sweeps away a swarm of zombies. Kill zombies running from all sides and survive.

- Unique maps : 'Abandoned Warehouse, Creepy Town, Rainy Village, Mysterious Fog, Desert of Monster Creatures, and Abandoned Slums' Days and Nights' show a mankind covered with fear and dark. Each map has its own unique atmosphere, and there are many different elements to overcome in order to clear. 

 

- Various weapons : Each map basically provides 3 kinds guns and grenades. The 3 kinds of guns are configured to match the characteristics of the map and can be used by changing them using a wheelboard.

- Equipment : Certain darkened maps are given Night Vision, Thermal Scope, Flashlight, Hands Flares, etc. to gain visibility.

- Horrifying atmosphere : Humans who have turned from the darkness of the end to zombies, mysterious creatures and monsters whose is unknown, and infected dogs.. The realistic expression is even more frightening.

- Customizing character : Player can choose a variety of costumes or change the color of each part.
